narrativeProgression.description: Matt Cimber describes Jayne Mansfield's comedic talents and her skill in playing the "straight man."
He shares an anecdote about Bob Hope using Jayne Mansfield as a joke, highlighting her ability to use humor to her advantage.
Cimber compares Mansfield to Marilyn Monroe, noting their different acting styles and personalities.
He discusses how Zanuck favored Marilyn Monroe over Jayne Mansfield.
Cimber recounts a story about a French director mistreating Jayne Mansfield on set, showcasing Zanuck's protectiveness of Mansfield.
